snippet.title: Arcade Game: Dragon Buster (1984 Namco)
snippet.description:
A Side-Scrolling Fighting Platform game with little Role-Playing elements where you travel through various scenery to rescue the princess from an evil dragon. This is the first game from Namco to include a life-bar system.

This game reminds me a cross between Dragon's Lair and Zelda. Pretty good game before Zelda.

This game took longer than expected as it's very time-consuming game.

Released in December 1984.

Note: No cheats and used only savestates all the way until level 12.  After level 12, the game repeats the last four levels endlessly until I run out of lives. After the last four previous levels start repeating, I used invincibility cheat to show that Cecilia the Princess can be kidnapped by the dragon if you do not have the scepter.
